## VantaVault v0.5.32

New notifications, account sign-in alerts and share cards.

### Highlights
- **Notifications** (notifications): A new notification center with skin art, Windows alerts for wishlist skins and startup options in Settings.
- **Accounts that need you** (accounts): A badge shows when a saved account needs a new sign-in.
- **Where your kills come from** (killspot): Map Takeaways show where your kills come from.

### Improved
- New share cards for matches, duos and loadouts.
- The current account stands out in the account switcher.
- An anonymous usage count (just a random ID and the app version); turn it off in Settings.
- Latest Tauri, Next.js and React.

### Fixed
- Only saved accounts that are due get renewed.

### Download
- **Windows Portable:** `VantaVault-portable.exe`
- **Windows Installer:** `VantaVault_0.5.32_x64-setup.exe`

### Auto-update
Both Windows versions update from inside VantaVault.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.31...v0.5.32
